content_sections.heading: About TNJFU
content_sections.text: Tamil Nadu Dr. J. Jayalalithaa Fisheries University is a state fisheries university with its OMR Campus at Vaniyanchavadi, Chennai. This notification, issued by the Dean (Basic sciences), TNJFU OMR Campus, fills teaching posts at the TNJFU-Institute of Fisheries Biotechnology on the same campus. Applications are received at the Institute of Fisheries Post Graduate Studies, OMR Campus.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notification announces 2 posts in total, one for each post listed below. All posts are at TNJFU-Institute of Fisheries Biotechnology. No category-wise break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Each post has its own qualification. The notification prints no experience requirement for either post. Ph.D in Statistics/Agricultural Statistics. The notification gives two sets of qualifications for this post. Each set carries a different pay. Set 1 (Rs. 45,000/- per month): Bachelor degree in Biotechnology and M.Tech./MSc in Biotechnology with NET qualification, or B.F.Sc. and M.F.Sc. in Fish Biotechnology/ Fish Genetics and Breeding with NET. Set 2 (Rs. 50,000/- per month): Bachelor degree in Biotechnology and M.Tech./MSc in Biotechnology and Ph.D in Biotechnology, or B.F.Sc. and M.F.Sc. in Fish Biotechnology/ Fish Genetics and Breeding and PhD in Fish Biotechnology/ Fish Genetics and Breeding. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The emoluments are consolidated and paid per month. The notification names no allowances on top of them. The posts are purely temporary. The engagement is initially for a period of one year. The posts are likely to be extended till the positions are filled on regular basis. The place of posting for both posts is TNJFU-Institute of Fisheries Biotechnology, OMR Campus, Vaniyanchavadi, Chennai-603103.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNJFU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are offline only. As of 4 November 2026 the deadline has not passed. The application should reach the Dean on or before 10 November 2026 (5.00 pm). Fill in the application in the format enclosed with the notification (page 2 of the PDF). Attach photocopies of all necessary certificates in support of your credentials. Write on the envelope: "Application for the post of Assistant Professor (Contractual) in TNJFU-Institute of Fisheries Biotechnology". Send the hard copy by post or hand it in person to: The Dean (Basic sciences), Institute of Fisheries Post Graduate Studies, OMR Campus, Vaniyanchavadi, Chennai-603 103. Make sure the application reaches the undersigned on or before 10.11.2026 (5.00 pm). The enclosed form, titled "Application for the post of Assistant Professor (Contractual)", asks for: Name of the applicant (in BLOCK LETTERS), father's name and date of birth Address for correspondence, with email ID and contact number Educational qualifications from SSLC and HSc onwards, with board/university, year of passing, % marks/OGPA and specialization, naming each degree Work experience Publications (books/manuals/research papers/popular articles) NET/SET/SLET qualification, medals and awards, and any other relevant information Place, date and signature of the applicant

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TNJFU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: one Assistant Professor – Statistics (Contractual) and one Assistant Professor (Contractual), both at TNJFU-Institute of Fisheries Biotechnology, Chennai.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the TNJFU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The application should reach the Dean (Basic sciences) on or before 10 November 2026 (5.00 pm).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for TNJFU Assistant Professor – Statistics?
faq.answer: A Ph.D in Statistics/Agricultural Statistics is required for the Assistant Professor – Statistics (Contractual) post.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the other TNJFU Assistant Professor (Contractual) post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor degree in Biotechnology and M.Tech./MSc in Biotechnology, or B.F.Sc. and M.F.Sc. in Fish Biotechnology/ Fish Genetics and Breeding, together with either NET or a Ph.D in Biotechnology/ Fish Biotechnology/ Fish Genetics and Breeding as the notification lists.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a TNJFU Assistant Professor (Contractual)?
faq.answer: The Statistics post pays Rs. 50,000/- per month. The other post pays Rs. 45,000/- per month with the NET qualification set and Rs. 50,000/- per month with the Ph.D qualification set, all consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for TNJFU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send a hard copy of the filled-in application in the enclosed format, with photocopies of certificates, by post or in person to The Dean (Basic sciences), Institute of Fisheries Post Graduate Studies, OMR Campus, Vaniyanchavadi, Chennai-603 103.

faq.question: Q7. What should be written on the application envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope should be superscribed "Application for the post of Assistant Professor (Contractual) in TNJFU-Institute of Fisheries Biotechnology".

faq.question: Q8. Is the TNJFU Assistant Professor job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary, initially for one year, and are likely to be extended till the positions are filled on regular basis.
